about: Recycled placeholder sounds (Garrett, 2026-11-16). Each entry is ONE sound the game owes: the banked event recycled into its slots until the target event is authored in FMOD Studio. Tools/Build/sound_placeholders.py applies, checks and promotes it; Docs/AudioSystem/PLACEHOLDERS.md is the list for Charles, generated from this file. Order is priority within a tier.

sounds.act: Every gun shot in the game: the GunFire category (FireGunActionExecutor, both Grizzly guns).
sounds.brief: REMAKE: `Gun Fire` exists and is banked but has no audio in it (no instrument in its metadata), so every gun has been silent. Fill that same event: the slot moves back to it on --promote. A short, punchy shot that repeats fast.

sounds.act: Every AOE blast in the game: the Explosion category (AOEExplosion on every blast prefab).
sounds.brief: REMAKE: `Explosion` exists and is banked but is empty, so every blast has been silent. Fill that same event. A full-bodied blast with a sub thump and a tail; the Mine Explode placeholder is the END GAME crash and too long.

sounds.act: The local pilot threads a gate, in every gate-race mode (23 modes).
sounds.brief: A short, bright, airy pass-through: a gate going by at speed, a second or less, every few seconds of every race. It must stay pleasant on the hundredth repeat (several takes, a little pitch variation).

sounds.act: The local pilot threads the last gate of the course.
sounds.brief: The finish line: the gate sound's big sibling, a resolving swell of 2-3 s. The match-end sounds follow it, so it should not be a fanfare of its own.

sounds.act: One tick per countdown number (3, 2, 1, GO) at the start of every match.
sounds.brief: A clean, tuned tick with weight; ideally GO is a different pitch or a second take (CHARLES_TASKS C9).

sounds.act: The Serpent's sniper fires.
sounds.brief: A long, thin, high-energy crack with a tail: the fleet's one precision weapon.

sounds.act: The Brittle Star's five guns fire.
sounds.brief: Five guns at once, rapid: a short, punchy shot that can repeat several times a second without fatigue.

sounds.act: The Scarab's dash: the whoosh at the start of the visual roll, every peer.
sounds.brief: A fast lateral whoosh with a roll in it, under half a second.

sounds.act: A skim paid the Manta energy (local pilot only, on every skim).
sounds.brief: A small rising fill tick, very short; it fires on every skim, so it must sit under the skim itself.

sounds.brief: A loop with a 0..1 `Boost Amount` parameter the code drives from the boost multiplier (a surge that swells with it). These three slots held the one-shot `Skim` (C4: it played once and drove nothing); they are cleared until this exists, and the skim tick in the same component keeps playing.
